name: django-celery
shape: Django with a Celery worker and beat

platform.name: Heroku
platform.why: the workflow's deploy_to_heroku job pushes to a Heroku app; the Procfile and runtime.txt are Heroku's files (the job is switched off with if: false)

processes.note: gunicorn config.wsgi:application; docker/web_entrypoint.sh starts the same for the Docker image
celery -A styleguide_example.tasks worker, broker RabbitMQ by CELERY_BROKER_URL
celery beat with django_celery_beat's DatabaseScheduler: the schedules live in Postgres, none are defined in code

data.note: DATABASES from DATABASE_URL, default postgres:///styleguide_example; docker-compose.yml runs postgres:14.1; also the Celery result backend (django-db)
the Celery broker (amqp), rabbitmq:alpine in docker-compose.yml; a queue broker, not a cache
FILE_UPLOAD_STORAGE defaults to local: uploads go to MEDIA_ROOT under the app folder; S3 is the other setting

notBreaks.why: a developer tool that rewrites README.md's table of contents; never runs on the server, and markdown_tools/ is not in NOT_APP
a management command that writes beat schedules (CrontabSchedule rows) into the database when run by hand; it is not a timer and its list of tasks is empty

notes: Read the Procfile, docker-compose.yml, docker/*, the workflow, config/django/*.py, config/settings/*.py and every app module outside migrations. Platform: the only deploy target in the repository is Heroku (Procfile with release/web/worker/beat, runtime.txt, a disabled deploy_to_heroku job; the README also mentions AWS ECS without files for it). The beat process is real and needs Cloud Scheduler after a move, but no in-process-timer line exists: with DatabaseScheduler the schedules are rows in Postgres and setup_periodic_tasks defines none. The release step (python manage.py migrate) is the release-migrations note, not a break, so it is listed as a process only. The uploads break is a configuration default (FILE_UPLOAD_STORAGE=local, also in .env.example); it disappears when the deployment sets S3. The Celery app is styleguide_example/tasks/celery.py, with tasks in styleguide_example/emails/tasks.py and blog_examples.

known.MISSED break: local-disk-write config/se: the storage or database is chosen in a settings module or a config key that no rule reads (FILE_UPLOAD_STORAGE defaults to local)
known.data missing: cache rabbi: the Celery broker is an amqp URL in a settings module, and no dependency names RabbitMQ
